My main street business folks are turning to their bankers and their bankers are trying to get signed up for the program to be able to do the loan applications process and send them straight to SBA. Some of my banks have been fortunate and worked really hard in their end. Their processing loans, they're moving along. There's still thousands I would suspect at this point of banks nationwide that have not cleared all the hurdles to get in and we're working with them and they're working with their banking associations to get in. If you spend the money on rent, employee salaries, utilities, the things that are spelled out, then the loan will be forgiven. If you spend the money as the terms specify, the loan will be forgiven. It's not a grant, but it's a loan that will be forgiven as long as you spend your money on your people and keeping your business going. I have frustration among my bankers because not all of my political banks were authorized small business administration, SBA loan generators to start with. They're overcoming that, just frustration. That's why this potential $250 billion they put into the fund plus it up to $600 billion is so important, Ron. That will give more money so there will be more money and more time for folks to work their way through these hurdles. but this is critically important. And along with the PPP as they call it, the Paycheck Protection Program, there's also money in there that helps back up the state's unemployment programs so that if your business that you work at fails, they can't hire you anymore. For whatever reason, they can't participate in PPP who have eight weeks of this state unemployment rate plus $600 to get you through hopefully what will be a narrow window in this pandemic. Bottom line is this, if those folks are able to make their payments, that is pay their rent by their groceries, pay their utilities, pay their car payments, continue to do the things they need to do, then we can tread water economically through the summer. so that when the pandemic passes and the economy takes off again, they will have their head above water and be able to go back to work.
